project_type: Flask web app with Jinja2 templates, vanilla JS frontend
build_system: Flask dev server, Dockerfile for deployment
test_command: No tests available - validation via syntax check and manual inspection
verification_instructions: 1. Check Python syntax: python -c 'import app'. 2. Validate JS syntax with node --check. 3. Verify no auto-calls to /api/test-gemini in frontend JS.
environment_constraints: No test framework. Validation is AST/syntax-based. Flask app loads google.generativeai which requires the package installed.
contribution_requirements: Do NOT touch TikTok Downloader logic. Do NOT refactor other systems. Focus only on MAKIMA AI.
key_patterns: Frontend is vanilla JS with DOM manipulation. CSS uses CSS custom properties from variables.css. Backend uses Flask with @app.route decorators. All static assets served from /static/. Cache busting via ?v= query strings in index.html.
directory_structure: Root: app.py (Flask), templates/index.html (single page), static/js/ (JS modules), static/css/ (CSS modules)
